faq.q: Which is better for AI agent workflows?
faq.a: n8n has a dedicated AI Agent node with structured tool calling across providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral and Groq, which suits developers building more complex agent logic. Make also offers AI Agents, currently in beta, with a built-in AI provider available on any plan, which is simpler to start with if you don't want to manage your own LLM key.

faq.q: Can Make handle AI automations?
faq.a: Yes, Make offers AI Agents, currently labeled beta, that run inside scenarios and can use Make's own built-in AI provider on any plan or your own LLM key. This lets you build autonomous agents directly alongside your regular automation workflows.
